Download manifest (url, sha256, licence, time)
nodes.description: Every download goes through one function that records its URL, checksum, size, licence and retrieval time; raw files are never edited.

nodes.label: Conform footprints
nodes.description: Repair geometries, flag overlaps and slivers (flag, don't drop), compute area, perimeter, compactness and orientation in UTM 35S, index to H3 r9, assign stable bldg_id.

nodes.label: Heights, floors, first seen
nodes.command: pixi run conform-height && pixi run derive
nodes.description: Sample Google 2.5D Temporal height and yearly presence (2016-2023) at each building; floors from height cut-points fitted on OSM building:levels (1 below 6.0 m, 2 below 8.5 m, +1 per 3 m); first-seen year where presence stays >= 0.5.

nodes.label: Vector context
nodes.description: Distances to major roads, any road and predicted MV lines; POI counts within 50/100/250 m; OSM/Overture tags and health facilities; admin names to village level.

nodes.label: Raster context
nodes.description: Sample GHSL settlement class and non-residential share, WorldPop density, Meta RWI and Copernicus DEM elevation at each building.

nodes.label: Climate to H3 r7
nodes.description: ERA5-Land hourly (Copernicus CDS, 0.1 deg, 2020-2025) interpolated to H3 r7 cell centres; temperature corrected to cell elevation (-6.16 K/km), local time UTC+2; diurnal and monthly means, tmax_p95, CDD18/22/24, humidity, rainfall, solar (GHI); cooling class.

nodes.label: NASA POWER cross-check
nodes.description: Independent hourly temperatures at 4 towns confirm cooling demand is marginal in most of Rwanda.

nodes.label: Context cards (open vector data only)
nodes.description: A text card per building: footprint, height, size against neighbours, land use, road frontage, nearby tags and places, density, settlement class, wealth, distances. No imagery.

nodes.label: Claude Haiku 4.5 labeller
nodes.description: Returns probabilities over 9 use classes plus the cues it relied on; every call cached and costed (~$3.6 per 1,000 buildings).

nodes.label: Label evaluation
nodes.description: 11 model/prompt configurations compared against human gold labels on accuracy, class variety and cost.

nodes.label: Evidence extraction with citations
nodes.description: Values extracted from the corpus with document, page and quote; quotes verified verbatim on the page (81%).

nodes.label: Hand-curated productive-use values
nodes.description: 37 values from NREL 2018, GIZ 2016 and the Power Africa Rwanda 2020 catalogue, each quote verified in code.

nodes.label: Automated plausibility checks
nodes.description: Units, physical/market ranges per appliance and agreement between sources; 17 of 1,077 values flagged and excluded.

nodes.label: Microdata to weighted aggregates
nodes.command: pixi run mtf-appliances && pixi run eicv5-electricity
nodes.description: Appliance ownership, hours, enterprise and facility use, spending converted to kWh with the RURA tariff in force. Aggregates only; cells under 10 respondents suppressed.

nodes.label: B1 archetype builder
nodes.description: 17 RAMP archetypes from recipes; every number cites survey data, evidence or measurements, or carries a written assumption; household lighting calibrated to MTF spending.

nodes.label: B2a use classifier (tags; tags + LLM)
nodes.description: Gradient boosting on footprint, height, context and H3 r9/r10 neighbourhood features. Model A learns from 36k tagged buildings, model B adds 44k LLM labels; held-out ranking AUC 0.78 (tags by district) and 0.76 (LLM by sector). Applied to all 6.4M buildings.

nodes.label: B3 productive-use census targets + tags
nodes.description: Census manufacturing establishments per district and setting, split into trades (mills rural; tailors, welders, carpenters in towns); trade tags locate 57 buildings.

nodes.label: B3s services census targets + tags
nodes.description: Census sections I and S (assumed splits) per district: bars/restaurants, guesthouses, salons; OSM/Overture tags locate 1,500 buildings.

nodes.label: B2b census-constrained allocation
nodes.description: Every census and registry count placed on buildings, rarest first: facility compounds (schools, health), productive use (one mill per H3 r8 cell), services, shops, MINEDUC schools, places of worship, offices/stores (LLM rate by setting), 3.31M census households urban and rural (up to one per floor) with the DHS wealth split; the remaining 46% are ancillary.

nodes.label: B4 grid-connection model
nodes.description: Logistic model of household grid connection (DHS 2025, displaced clusters) on neighbourhood features; grouped CV by district (AUC 0.75); checked against EICV7 district grid lighting (r = 0.93).

nodes.label: Registry and survey targets
nodes.command: pixi run fetch-schools && pixi run dhs-wealth
nodes.description: MINEDUC schools per district (5,904), a national worship count (7,000, spread by households), DHS 2025 upper-wealth share per district x setting (restricted microdata -> aggregate).

nodes.label: B4c calibration: EICV7 grid shares + REG consumption
nodes.description: P(connected) shifted per district on the logit scale to match EICV7 2024; household energy scaled so a connected household uses REG's mean (Kigali 24.8, elsewhere 5.9 kWh/month). Gives potential and expected kWh per building.

nodes.label: B5y demand by year
nodes.description: Back-cast 2016-2023 from each building's detected presence, district stock pinned to census household growth (3.1%/yr); connection rolled back to EICV5 2017; projection to 2030 by district growth.

nodes.label: B6 uncertainty and cap sensitivity
nodes.description: 10 allocations with perturbed class probabilities (sector p10/p50/p90, per-building use agreement) and spacing caps x0.5 to none.

nodes.label: Night lights per H3 cell and year
nodes.description: Black Marble VNP46A4 (Collection 2) annual radiance 2016-2024 from Earthdata Cloud, averaged per H3 r8 cell. Not yet a model input.

nodes.label: B3 RAMP 0.5.2 simulation
nodes.description: 200 units x 28 days per profile; per-unit hourly means (all days, weekdays, weekends), daily kWh spread and coincident peaks.

nodes.label: B4 building and area metrics
nodes.description: The five headline metrics per building (deep dives) and per selection, from weights x profiles.

nodes.label: Profile checks
nodes.description: Households vs QSEL meter data and EICV5 spending; schools, mills and workshops vs MTF and NREL; MTF energy tiers.

nodes.label: Table QA (schema contracts)
nodes.description: Every table validated against its pandera contract; reports in reports/qa.
